> RETRORGB                              
  PS2 Slim: M.2 SATA SSD Mod Debuts     
                                        
  The M2 Slim hardware modification     
  enables internal M.2 SATA storage     
  inside SCPH-700XX revision consoles,  
  eliminating slow USB 1.1 bottlenecks  
  for faster Open PS2 Loader playback.  
                                        
  Source: RetroRGB (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)
